assumptions: Agents possess a mechanism for quantifying uncertainty within their own trust boundaries.
Information gain provides a measurable proxy for reducing architectural unpredictability.
Trust boundaries act as constraints on permissible inquiry domains.
definition.falsification: Inquiry strategies prioritizing broad state coverage result in higher stability metrics than those targeting trust boundary uncertainty.
definition.statement: Autonomous inquiry efficiency is maximized when agents prioritize information gain that reduces uncertainty in model trust boundaries, rather than optimizing for broad state coverage.
definition.uncertainty: The mapping between information gain metrics and the 'trust boundaries' described in architectural specifications is not yet formalized.
